summary: Clearwater County tower named River, listed by the Forest Fire Lookout Association as gone; no build, owner or design source found.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone by the Forest Fire Lookout Association.

evidence.supports: tower named River in Clearwater County, listed as gone, with coordinates

notes_for_editor: Only one source: the Forest Fire Lookout Association list, which gives the name, county, coordinates and gone status. The Clearwater County survey PDF on Wikimedia Commons does not include River. A statewide A-Z list has a bare 'River' name between Ridge and Rock Cut with no details I could match to this site, so it is not cited. The story is about 40 words because nothing else was found; it needs a build, owner or design source before it can be expanded. Two web searches and the cached register pages gave no River-specific page.
